name: Restart Container on Down
description: Receives POST webhook notifications from Uptime Kuma when a monitored Docker container goes down (heartbeat status=0). Automatically restarts the failed container by running 'docker compose up -d --force-recreate' in the matching service directory under /mnt/e/Docker/. The service directory is resolved from the Uptime Kuma monitor name (lowercased). Requires the monitor name in Uptime Kuma to exactly match the Docker service folder name.

parameters.command: =if ! command -v docker &> /dev/null; then apk add --no-cache docker-cli docker-cli-compose; fi && cd "/mnt/e/Docker/{{ $json.body.monitor.name.toLowerCase() }}" && docker compose up -d --force-recreate
